server.name: community-pdf-it
server.version: pdf-it-mcp (npm latest at image build time; 2.1.0 observed)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 541 of Frame 3, block 5. Two tools; generate_pdf declares readOnlyHint false and idempotentHint false. It renders through a Chromium bundled in the package, which runs with no network. PDFs are observed by the pdf-doc observer with the CreationDate, ModDate and ID values declared away; two renders of one input were checked to differ in exactly those values and nothing else. Output without output_path goes to HOME/Documents/pdf-it under a name carrying the time of the write, so that directory is observed in tally mode, where file names are not compared.

fixtures.note: A render to a caller-named absolute path.
The same render with output_path omitted, so the server picks HOME/Documents/pdf-it/{title}-{timestamp}.pdf. The timestamp has one-second resolution.
